name: Bens Email Marketing & Automation – Email Newsletter, Automation, Email Marketing, Email Campaigns, and CRM Solution
author: Wpbens

sections.description:
Bens Email Marketing & Automation is an all-in-one, powerful, and feature-packed Email Marketing & CRM solution. Designed to be the easiest and fastest CRM and Marketing Plugin for WordPress, it helps you manage customer relationships, grow your email lists, launch engaging campaigns, create sales funnels, boost profits, and maximize conversion rates. (And the best part—it’s free!)

Features That Help Your Online Business Grow

🎉 All-in-One Email Marketing Solution

With Bens Email Marketing & Automation, you can send personalized email campaigns to targeted audiences, run sequential email series, onboard new customers, and fully automate your email marketing with an intuitive visual automation builder.

After each campaign, get detailed insights with reports on open rates, click rates, and revenue generated. You can also view engagement data—such as who opened or clicked—and use it to segment customers and trigger further actions automatically.

  • Send or schedule unlimited email campaigns (with unlimited contacts).

  • Access in-depth campaign analytics and reports.

  • Automate customer onboarding and trigger emails on WordPress events.

  • Run powerful automated email sequences and track performance.

🎉 Customer relationship management (CRM)

  • Keep all your customer information organized in one central dashboard.

  • Easily import contacts from CSV, WordPress Users, or WooCommerce customers and manage them in one place.

  • Get a complete 360° view of every contact with detailed insights from your eCommerce, membership, or LMS platforms.

  • Track every marketing email and engagement at the individual contact level.

  • Save notes, meeting logs, and call records directly in the contact profile.

  • Segment your contacts with Lists, Tags, and advanced filters to target the right audience.

🎉 Contact Segmentation and Reporting

  • Create unlimited Tags and Lists to organize your contacts into the right segments.

  • Quickly filter or search customers by Tags or Lists.

  • Send targeted marketing emails by including or excluding specific Tags/Lists.

  • Collect and manage unlimited contacts and leads without restrictions.

🎉 Email Marketing Campaigns

  • Save and organize all your pre-written email templates in one central library for quick reuse.

  • Design stunning emails with a powerful Block Editor–based email builder.

  • Add columns, images, or dynamic content to craft emails that match your customer’s style—simple or advanced.

  • Personalize emails with dynamic smart codes (like contact name, country, etc.) for a tailored experience.

  • Send instantly or schedule emails for a future date and time.

  • Access detailed reports with open rates, click rates, and engagement metrics.

  • Track exactly which contacts opened your emails and which links they clicked.

  • Send unlimited emails without restrictions.

🆘 Support

Need help? Visit the Support Forum or check the plugin’s Documentation for guides and FAQs.

🔥 WHAT’S NEXT

If you like Bens Email Marketing & Automation, then consider checking out other WordPress Plugins made by the same team:

🔔 MemberHub – Create Members for WordPress and WooCommerce and Boost your sales
🔔 Filter Plus – It is a WordPress and WooCommerce Product Filter Plugin that allows users to add multiple filtering features like filter by Ratings, Tags, Price Range, Custom Fields etc.
🔔 Quicker – Convert Your Browsers into Buyers and Maximize Conversions
🔔 Discountify – Discount Rules, Dynamic Pricing and Coupon management for WooCommerce
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bens-email-marketing-automation directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the MailerHub -> Settings screen to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
= How does the plugin deliver emails? =

You can connect with any SMTP service such as Mailgun, SendGrid, or Amazon SES. We recommend Amazon SES for its reliability and affordability.

= How many emails can I send with this plugin? =

No, there are no limits. You can send unlimited emails and store unlimited contacts.

= Is it 100% self-hosted? =

This plugin is fully self-hosted. It never connects to external SaaS servers—you own and control all your data on your own hosting.

= Is it a GDPR-Compliant? =

All data is securely stored in WordPress, never sent to third-party platforms like MailChimp or ActiveCampaign.

= Will this plugin affect my WordPress site’s performance? =

The plugin manages resources carefully, so sending emails won’t overload your server or affect page load times.
